tools.name: law.search
tools.description: Searches US federal, state, and municipal law by topic or keyword (legality, permits, zoning, licensing, compliance, filing requirements). Returns ranked provisions with verbatim citations, headings, snippets, and node ids. `jurisdiction` limits results to one state, federal law, or a city.

tools.name: law.get_node
tools.description: Returns the full official text, citation, and hierarchy of one legal provision, by its node id (the UUID in search results).

tools.name: law.list_coverage
tools.description: Lists the covered jurisdictions (federal, state, and municipal) with per-jurisdiction provision counts, searchable-chunk counts, GIS status, and a placeholder flag.

tools.name: account.status
tools.description: Reports the credit balance, tier, rate limits, and upgrade options for the API key on this connection, or the free-tier allowance and the key URL for an anonymous caller. Free — this call does not consume a credit. Also mints or returns a referral code; `referral_code` on later calls keeps the same

tools.name: formation.requirements
tools.description: Returns the intake checklist for forming an LLC (limited liability company) or nonprofit corporation in one US state: every required field, that state's specific questions, live all-in pricing including the state filing fee, and the optional EIN add-on with its price when available. Free; does not c

tools.name: formation.compare
tools.description: Compares LLC formation providers on price, recurring costs, registered-agent renewals, and machine/agent capabilities, from a dated dataset of 19 LLC services + 1 adjacent verified against primary sources. Corpus is one of the compared providers and is scored with the same rubric, including its own

tools.name: formation.lookup_naics
tools.description: Returns candidate NAICS industry codes (typically 2–6) for a plain-English business description. A code is required for every LLC, and for nonprofits in AK, CT, LA, MS, TN, WV. Free; does not consume credits.

tools.name: formation.handoff
tools.description: Validates an LLC or nonprofit formation draft (people, address, management, EIN answers, state-specific answers) and returns exactly what is still missing. A complete draft also returns a prefilled corpuslaw.us link that opens the formation agent with every detail loaded, where the founder reviews,

tools.name: formation.checkout
tools.description: Creates the founder's LLC or nonprofit formation order and a USDC (Solana) payment request — no API key, no Corpus sign-in. Payment is USDC on Solana ONLY. tools.name: formation.payment_status
tools.description: Reports the USDC payment state of an LLC or nonprofit formation order created by formation.checkout: awaiting, paid, expired, underpaid or held, plus whether the founder has confirmed by email (required within 48 hours of payment).
